selection: every no-overflow case upstream added after the pin, restricted to the directories that rule names: 265 cases in 8 directories run, 6807 further additions counted and not run. Machine-readable form in `selection_rule` and in `census.json`; nothing in the selection reads a verdict or a solver result.

selection_rule.membership: named by one of the collection's own c/*.set files at the new pin
selection_rule.inclusion: declares no-overflow.prp with an expected_verdict, and none of its input_files exists at the pin under the same c/<directory>/ path
selection_rule.run_set: (a) all added cases in the four directories absent at the pin (hacl-star, goblint-coreutils, argv-c, coreutils-v8.31); (b) all added cases in the four nonlinear-invariant directories (nla-digbench, nla-digbench-scaling, recursified_nla-digbench, termination-nla)
selection_rule.not_run: the rest of the additions are counted and named per directory; they are an input-language question, not a solver question
selection_rule.outcome_blind: no verdict, and no solver result of any kind, enters this selection

labels: expected_verdict of no-overflow.prp in the same .yml, for scoring only
llmloop_configuration: unchanged front end scripts/svcomp_translate.py with GHOST on and NOOVF on; deterministic default then polynomial profile only if the default does not prove; 60 samples, 150 rounds, 5 s per query, seed 1
cbmc_configuration: --no-standard-checks --signed-overflow-check --unwind 64 --unwinding-assertions, actual ABI; incomplete unrolling is UNKNOWN
ultimate_configuration: unmodified v0.3.2 release, default/bitvector portfolio, JVM Xmx1G, internal timeout 600 s inside the same 600 s host cap
timing: concurrent throughput observations, not cross-tool speedup
